name: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive Taxi
summary:
Teach My Little Sister How To Drive Taxi 🚕

You're a taxi driver. You're also a driving instructor. Unfortunately, your student is your little sister. What could possibly go wrong?

Welcome to Teach My Little Sister How To Drive Taxi, a hilarious driving simulator where your mission is simple: teach your little sister how to become the best taxi driver in town!

There's just one tiny problem... she's watching EVERYTHING you do.

Every turn, every traffic light, every questionable parking decision, and ever
